[Intro]
[Bb5]

[Verse]
[B5]They can't fool me.
Wearing human faces.
They're nothing but
resonance Frequen-
cies escaping the
grasp of my mind.
Waveforms are
spinning out of control.
Leaking into
parallel dimen
sions. My mind
is turned inside out.
Exteriorized
mind. Perceptually...
Bombardment
from ootside.
[Eb5]Unearthly thought waves
overcharge my brain circuits.

[Outro]
[Bb5]
